_about: Manifest of every twp-shaped .jsonl cell on disk, one row per LINE so redundancy survives. Provenance is RECORDED (path, dir, line) and never inferred from scan order -- an earlier audit attributed cells to whichever directory a glob met first and reported data/twp_cloud as 88.4% un-ingested when the true figure over its own contents is 13.9%. `in_ch` is NOT stored: it is a statement about a moment and belongs in a report with a timestamp, not frozen into an artifact.
